description: Twenty-six rain readings are exactly -9999: the logger's 'no data' code for days when the tipping bucket jammed, including a two-week outage at Lake Division in July. Summed or averaged as if they were rainfall, they drag the year's total deep into negative millimetres. df.describe() shows the impossible minimum and a negative mean at once. -9999 is the same missing-value code NOAA's GHCN-Daily station files use, and it has quietly poisoned many an average; this estate and its data are fictional.
hints: Start with df.describe() and ask whether every minimum and maximum is physically possible.
Look at the rainfall column. Can rain be negative, and what is its minimum?
Twenty-six rain_mm readings are exactly -9999, a 'no data' code being treated as real rainfall.
